messages:
sarah: Quick follow-up on the deferred tokenization + audit-fence idea from yesterday's RFC. I sketched an approach where we delay full per-token attribution until a finalize event, but keep a compact provenance fence to support audits and provisional billing.
jon: tl;dr? what's the win vs immediate-tokenize flow?
sarah: Avoid doing expensive tokenization for every short-lived/aborted request. Materialize tokens only for finalized responses. Also simplifies chunked-response handshake semantics.
priya: Concern: how long can we defer without breaking near-RT billing dashboards? Customers expect <1m visibility.
evan: Proposed: 30s soft-window for provisional visibility + eventual reconciliation for items finalized after that. Dashboard shows provisional counters then flips to final after materialization.
mike: Implementation idea: write a compact provenance_fence at ingest (~200 bytes): fingerprint, tenant, model, seq-range, provisional_tokens, signature. Finalizer expands fence into tokens when needed.
sarah: Example ingest fence (stored as a single row):
```
{
  "request_id": "r_abc123",
  "tenant": "acct_42",
  "model": "open-redwood-1",
  "provenance_fence": {
    "fp": "sha256:deadbeef",
    "seq_range": "0-345",
    "prefix_hash": "h12...",
    "provisional_tokens": 42
  },
  "status": "streaming"
}
```
priya: provisional_tokens lets console show best-effort cost, but billing needs finalized token counts and fine-grained attribution (function-calls vs user tokens). How do we map back?
jon: Finalizer should be able to deterministically re-run tokenizer from prefix_hash + seq_range so we don't need to persist the full prompt. That keeps PII out of the fence.
evan: Auditing: auditors want tamper-evident chain. We should sign the fence (HMAC) and append an entry to an append-only audit log at ingest.
audit-bot: audit: created issue A-412 to track "provenance_fence signing and append-only audit-log" — https://issues.example/A-412 :lock:
sarah: Signature sketch: HMAC-SHA256 over (tenant, request_id, fp, seq_range, timestamp) using KMS key; store signature in fence. Finalizer verifies signature before expanding.
mike: Edge cases: replays and late-arrivals. Finalizer must be idempotent: state machine ingest -> fence_written -> finalized -> credits_emitted. Use CAS on request_id state to avoid double-crediting.
priya: Cross-region concern: if ingest in us-east and finalizer in eu-west, KMS access patterns get tricky.
evan: Two options: A) sign with tenant-local KMS in ingest region and replicate fence to finalizer region; B) finalizer calls control plane to verify signature (control plane has central KMS). A is simpler operationally but increases ingest latency if we wait for signature.
jon: Storage format: fence to kafka topic for streaming consumers + compact KV store for fast lookup by request_id (finalizer CAS). Need cheap scans for reconciliation.
mike: I propose: write fence to provenance-fence kafka topic, have a connector populate a compact row into cassandra/dynamo keyed by request_id for fast CAS and finalizer access. Reconciliation jobs read kafka+compact-store.
priya: UX: show provisional vs finalized metrics in console, mark provisional rows, and surface time-to-finalize histogram. Also a clear note that provisional costs may change. I'll own console copy and changelog.
sarah: Rollout plan: feature-flag deferred-tokenization. Start with 10% of noisy/retry-heavy traffic, run finalizer in passive (validate-only) mode for 2w, then enable credits emission after we prove idempotency.
deploy-bot: deploy status: sarah/deferred-tokenization -> canary started (10%) :rocket:
jon: Action items: 1) fence schema + signature fields (sarah) 2) finalizer idempotency state machine + CAS semantics (mike) 3) reconciliation window + dashboard UX (priya) 4) security review for KMS pattern (evan) 5) changelog for billing behavior and SLAs (priya)
priya: I'll take dashboard UX + changelog. Assigning to myself.
sarah: I'll draft the implementation PR with schema + HMAC details and ping for reviews. :thumbsup:
mike: I'll prototype kafka->kv sync and a CAS example for finalizer.
evan: I'll open a short security review on cross-region KMS and sign/verify pattern.
audit-bot: audit: linked A-412 to epic EP-77 (metering reliability).
